blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Test-time context optimization adapts frozen language models through textual feedback, but ordinary conditional generation provides no separate control over how strongly to reinforce the distributional changes induced by a context update. We introduce EMO, a training-free framework inspired by expectation--maximization that alternates question-specific context estimation (E-step) and distribution refinement (M-step). The E-step revises a system context using textual gradients from an external judge without access to gold answers. The M-step contrasts next-token distributions under the revised and preceding contexts at a shared prefix to construct a confidence-constrained logit correction. Feedback on the steered response drives the next context update, coupling adaptation across rounds with intervention within each generation. Theoretically, we connect parameter and context optimization through a shared target-KL objective and additive logit representations, and derive the steering vector from context-induced logit displacements. Under context-improvement and faithful-steering assumptions, we prove a one-round decrease in target KL divergence for sufficiently small steering strength. Under greedy decoding across eight models and six benchmarks, EMO improves the zero-shot baseline in 39 of 40 aggregated settings, averaging $+9.10$ percentage points. With the same judge, it adds $+1.53$ points on average over context-only optimization (TextGrad), with consistent MMLU-Pro gains across models. At matched target-model generation budgets, accuracy advantages over best-of-$N$ are strongest on Llama, while oracle coverage is higher in most comparisons despite fewer candidates. The coverage--selection gap motivates allocating test-time computation jointly to candidate generation and verification.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Parameter updates and context refinement provide complementary routes to adapting a large language model (LLM).
Parameter optimization, including fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, and preference alignment, incorporates task data or feedback into model weights ( Hu et al., 2021 ; Shao et al., 2024 ; Rafailov et al., 2023 ) .
For an individual test question, context optimization adapts a frozen model by using feedback to revise its textual instructions before generating a new response ( Yuksekgonul et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Madaan et al., 2023 ) .
We study how to translate such question-specific feedback into explicit control of the decoding process.
blocks.zh:
参数更新和上下文的改进为适应大型语言模型(LLM)提供了互补的路径.
参数优化,包括微调,强化学习和偏好相接,将任务数据或反馈纳入模型权重(Hu等,2021;Shao等,2024;Rafailov等,2023.).
对于单个测试问题,上下文优化通过使用反馈修改其文本指令来调整被冻结的模型,再生成新的响应(Yukekgonul等,2024;Zhang等,2026;Madaan等,2023).
我们研究如何将这种针对具体问题的反馈转化为对解码过程的明确控制.

blocks.en:
A revised context already changes the next-token distribution at every prefix.
Ordinary conditional generation, however, provides no separate control over the strength or token support of those changes.
Comparing the distributions before and after a context update reveals how the revision changes token preferences at the current prefix.
This motivates our central question: how can feedback-driven context updates supply a controllable intervention on the generation they guide?
blocks.zh:
修改的上下文已经改变每个前缀的下一个托肯分布 。
然而,普通有条件的一代对这些变化的强度或象征性支持没有单独的控制。
比较上下文更新前后的分布会揭示修订在当前前缀中如何改变符号偏好.
这激发了我们的中心问题:如何通过反馈驱动的上下文更新,为它们引导的生成提供可控的干预?

blocks.en:
We propose EMO , which alternates context optimization and distribution refinement for each question.
The E-step revises a system context using textual gradients ( Yuksekgonul et al., 2024 ) from an external judge without access to gold answers.
The M-step compares the revised and preceding contexts at a shared generated prefix, constructs a steering vector from their distribution contrast, and applies a confidence-constrained correction to the revised context’s logits.
The resulting response is evaluated to provide feedback for the next E-step.
Each context update thus determines a decoding intervention whose output informs the next update, closing the loop while model weights remain fixed.
blocks.zh:
我们建议由EMO来替代每个问题的上下文优化和分配完善。
E-step使用文本梯度(Yukskgonul等,2024年)从外部法官处修改一个系统上下文,而无法获得黄金答案.
M步比对了共享生成的前缀中经过修改的和先前的上下文,从分布对比中构建出一个向导矢量,并对经过修改的上下文日志应用了一种受信任限制的校正.
对由此产生的答复进行评价,以便为下一个电子步骤提供反馈。
因此,每个上下文更新都会决定一个解码干预,其输出为下一次更新提供参考,在模型权重保持不变的情况下关闭循环.

blocks.en:
A logit-space view explains the relationship between the two steps.
Parameter and context updates both admit additive logit representations, while EMO uses the context-induced displacement to construct its additional steering correction.
Context edits induce finite logit changes through a frozen model, whereas parameter updates also alter the model’s response to subsequent contexts and prefixes.
This representation links adaptation to decoding, while our one-round analysis identifies sufficient conditions for improvement toward a target distribution.

这种表述方式将调整与解码联系起来,而我们的一回合分析则确定了改进目标分配的充分条件。

blocks.en:
Across eight models and six benchmarks, EMO improves over Base in 39 of 40 aggregated settings, averaging + 9.10 +9.10 percentage points, with benefits spanning model scale, generation, family, and thinking mode.
With the judge and candidate count held fixed, adding the M-step yields + 1.53 +1.53 points on average over context-only optimization and improves MMLU-Pro for all eight models.
At matched target-model generation budgets, EMO also achieves higher oracle coverage than independent sampling in seven of nine settings despite producing fewer candidates, indicating benefits in candidate generation alongside improvements in selected accuracy.

blocks.en: Our contributions are summarized as follows: • EMO: coupled context optimization and steering. A training-free framework that turns successive context updates into prefix-dependent decoding interventions and uses the steered responses to drive further context adaptation. • Logit-space interpretation and conditional analysis. We relate the context-induced logit displacement to the implemented steering vector (Eq. 5 ) and establish one-round target-KL improvement under context-improvement and faithful-steering assumptions (Theorem 1 ). • Empirical evidence across four model axes. Broad improvements over Base and additional gains over context-only optimization, supported by component ablations, decoding comparisons, and generation-budget analyses that distinguish candidate coverage from answer selection.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Parameter optimization. Parameter adaptation includes supervised fine-tuning and its parameter-efficient variants ( Hu et al., 2021 ) , reinforcement learning ( Schulman et al., 2017 ; Shao et al., 2024 ; Guo et al., 2025 ; Yu et al., 2025 ) , preference optimization ( Rafailov et al., 2023 ) , and distillation ( Snell et al., 2022 ; Agarwal et al., 2024 ) .
These approaches incorporate training signals into model weights.
EMO operates on a frozen checkpoint and uses feedback on the current question to adapt its context and decoding, making it complementary to parameter adaptation.
blocks.zh:
参数优化. 参数适应包括有监督的微调及其参数效率变体(Hu等,2021年),强化学习(Schulman等,2017年;Shao等,2024年;Guo等,2025年;Yu等,2025年),偏好优化(Rafailov等,2023年)和分馏(Snell等,2022年;Agarwal等,2024年).
这些方法将培训信号纳入模型加权。
EMO在被冻结的检查站上运作,并使用对当前问题的反馈来调整其上下文并进行解码,使其能补充参数调整.

blocks.en:
Context optimization. A second line adapts textual inputs while keeping model weights frozen, including textual gradients and prompt optimization ( Yuksekgonul et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2024 ) , self-correction ( Madaan et al., 2023 ; Shinn et al., 2023 ; Gou et al., 2024 ) , and agentic context engineering that evolves skills and memories ( Zhang et al., 2026 ; Ye et al., 2026 ) .
These approaches use textual revisions to influence subsequent generation.
EMO’s E-step builds on this idea; its M-step additionally uses the distributional change between successive contexts to control decoding at each prefix.
The steered response then becomes the basis for further textual feedback.
blocks.zh:
环境优化. 第二行调整了文字输入,同时使模型重量被冻结,包括文字梯度和即时优化(Yukekgonul等,2024;Yang等,2024;自修正(Madaan等,2023;Shinn等,2023;Gou等,2024;),以及演化技能和记忆的代理上下文工程(Zhang等,2026;Ye等,2026.).
这些方法使用文字修改来影响后产生.
EMO的E-step基于这个想法;它的M-step额外利用相继上下文之间的分布变化来控制每个前缀的解码.
指导性的答复随后成为进一步文字反馈的基础。

blocks.en:
Inference-time intervention. A third family controls generation at inference time by modifying internal activations ( Turner et al., 2023 ) or contrasting next-token distributions during decoding ( Li et al., 2023 ) .
Closely related task-aware approaches include CoS ( He et al., 2025 ) , SDA ( Xia and Deng, 2026 ) , SVDecode ( Hu et al., 2026 ) , and JitRL ( Li et al., 2026 ) .
EMO connects decoding-time intervention to per-question context optimization: each response informs the next context update, whose distribution contrast supplies the steering signal at every subsequent prefix.
The logit-space view in Section 3.1 formalizes how these context updates determine prefix-dependent decoding interventions.
Test-time compute can also be spent on parallel sampling, including self-consistency ( Wang et al., 2022 ) and best-of- N N with a verifier or judge ( Cobbe et al., 2021 ; Brown et al., 2024 ) , or sequential refinement ( Snell et al., 2024 ) .
Our experiments compare EMO with context-only refinement and, separately, with SC/BoN at matched target-model generation budgets (Section 4.4 ).
blocks.zh:

密切相关的任务认识方法包括CoS(He等人,2025年),SDA。 (夏和邓,2026). SVDecode. (Hu等,2026年),和JitRL(Li等,2026年).
EMO将解码-时间干预与每个问题上下文优化连接起来:每个响应都会告知下个上下文更新,其分布对比值在之后的每一个前缀都提供方向信号.
第3.1节中的对数-空间视图正式确定了这些上下文更新如何确定前缀依赖的解码干预.
试验时间计算还可以花在平行取样上,包括自相容性(Wang等,2022年)和有核查员或裁判员的N型最佳N型(Cobbe等,2021年;Brown等,2024年),或相继改进(Snell等,2024年).
我们的实验将EMO与仅针对具体情况的改进进行比较,并在相应的目标模型生成预算中分别与SC/BON进行比较(第4.4节)。

blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en:
EMO couples context refinement and decoding interventions through feedback on generated responses.
Context updates induce question-specific changes in token preferences; steering converts these changes into controlled logit corrections at each decoding prefix.
We first relate the two updates in logit space, then describe the algorithm and the conditions for target alignment.

blocks.en:
We evaluate eight models spanning 3B–32B parameters and two families: Qwen3-8B/14B/32B, Qwen2.5-7B, Qwen3.5-9B, DeepSeek-R1-0528-Qwen3-8B, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, and Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct, covering both thinking and non-thinking models (Appendix B.2 ).
We use six benchmarks covering multiple-choice and free-form formats: AIME-2025, AIME-2026, GPQA-Diamond, GSM8K, MATH-500, and MMLU-Pro (560 questions: 40 per category, sampling seed 42).
The main table averages the two AIME editions into one of five equally weighted task groups (Appendix B.1 ).

The external judge, Qwen3.5-122B-A10B (FP8), assigns scores from 0 to 10 without access to gold answers; feedback prompts forbid final-answer disclosure.
Judge prompting and decoding settings are detailed in Appendix B.3 .
Reported accuracy uses task-specific answer extraction and gold-based correctness rules, independently of judge scores.
Under judge-select , the highest-scoring response among the initial generation and K K optimization rounds is selected, with ties resolved in favor of the earliest response.
We separately report oracle coverage : the fraction of questions with at least one correct response in the candidate pool.

blocks.en:
We compare Base (zero-shot decoding) and TextGrad (our E-step without the M-step), adapting TextGrad from task-level to per-question optimization to match our protocol.
TextGrad and EMO share the initial context, baseline response, judge, and K = 4 K=4 optimization rounds, with judge-select over five candidates.
EMO uses fixed defaults μ = 2.4 \mu=2.4 and α = 0.1 \alpha=0.1 (Appendix B.5 ).
Main results use greedy target decoding; budget comparisons use temperature 0.6, top- p p 0.95, and seeds { 0 , 1 , 2 } \{0,1,2\} against self-consistency (SC) and best-of- N N (BoN) (Section 4.4 ). Paired significance tests compare EMO at N = 9 N=9 with Base and BoN@10 (Appendix B.4.5 ).
Full decoding settings and token limits appear in Appendix B.3 .

TextGrad和EMO分享了初始上下文,基线响应,法官,和K = 4 K = 4 优化回合,由法官选出超过5名候选人.

blocks.en: 4.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 主要成果

blocks.en:
Table 1 separates overall gains over Base from incremental gains over context-only optimization. EMO improves over Base in 39 of 40 cells (47 of 48 before merging the two AIME editions), averaging + 9.10 +9.10 percentage points across the 40 model–task-group pairs.
All eight models improve on average; EMO also exceeds TextGrad in 25 cells and ties in four, with a mean increment of + 1.53 +1.53 points.
Using Qwen3-8B as a common reference, we organize the analysis along four axes: model scale, generation, family, and thinking mode.
blocks.zh:
表1将总收益与基地相比,将增量收益与仅次于背景的优化区分开来。 在40个单元中的39个单元(48个单元中的47个单元在合并两个AIME版之前)中,EMO比Base有所改善,40个模型-任务组对的平均分数为+9.10+9.10分.
所有8个型号均得到平均改善;EMO在25个单元格中也超过了TextGrad,在4个带子中也超过了TextGrad,平均递增为+1.53分.
我们用Quen3-8B作为共同的参考,沿着四个轴线组织分析:模型尺度,生成,家族,和思维模式.

blocks.en:
We first test whether adaptation benefits persist as target models scale.
Qwen3-14B with EMO exceeds Qwen3-32B Base on all five task groups, averaging 69.80 69.80 versus 63.86 63.86 .
Likewise, optimized Llama-3.2-3B exceeds Llama-3.1-8B Base on every task group.
Larger models also retain substantial gains: Qwen3-32B improves by 8.68 8.68 points on average and 30.0 30.0 on AIME.
Accuracy headroom alone is insufficient to predict improvement: Qwen3 gains little on near-saturated GSM8K, yet Llama gains little on AIME despite near-zero baselines.
Mean gains across Qwen3-8B/14B/32B are non-monotonic ( 9.42 / 7.44 / 8.68 9.42/7.44/8.68 ): model size alone does not determine adaptation benefit.
Adaptation can close size-related gaps, but its benefit depends on whether feedback-guided generation can reach correct solutions.
blocks.zh:
我们首先检验适应效益是否作为目标模型继续存在。
标有 EMO 的 Quen3-14B 超过 Quen3-32B (中文(简体) ). 基于所有五个工作组,平均69.80 69.80,对63.86 63.86。
同样,优化 拉玛-3.2-3B超过拉玛-3.1-8B 以每个工作组为基础。
较大的模型也保留了巨大的收益:Qune3-32B平均提高8.68分,AIME提高30.03分.
光是准确的头室不足以预测改善情况: Qune3在接近饱和的GSM8K上得分很少,而Llama尽管基线接近零,但在AIME上得分很少.
总体平均收益 Qune3-8B/14B/32B是非模拟的(9.42 / 7.44 / 8.68 9.42/744/8.68):单是模型大小不能确定适应效益。
适应可以缩小与规模有关的差距,但其好处取决于反馈引导生成能否找到正确的解决办法。

blocks.en:
Across Qwen2.5-7B, Qwen3-8B, and Qwen3.5-9B, EMO yields mean gains of 9.64 9.64 , 9.42 9.42 , and 6.40 6.40 points over Base.
The incremental gains over TextGrad are 2.74 2.74 , 1.76 1.76 , and 4.74 4.74 points, respectively: the newest generation has the smallest overall gain but the largest M-step increment.
On Qwen3.5-9B, context-only optimization gains just 1.66 1.66 points on average, whereas the full method gains 6.40 6.40 .
AIME makes this contrast concrete: Base, TextGrad, and EMO score 25.0 25.0 , 26.7 26.7 , and 45.0 45.0 .
Thus, limited gains from context rewrites need not imply limited scope for adaptation: steering can further exploit the distributional changes induced by those rewrites.
blocks.zh:
在Quen2.5-7B、Quen3-8B和Quen3.5-9B之间,EMO的产量平均收益为9.64 9.64分、9.42 9.42分和6.40 6.40分。
相对于TextGrad的增益分别为2.74 2.74分,1.76 1.76分和4.74 4.74分:最新一代的总增益最小,而M级增益最大.
在Quen3.5-9B上,仅上下文的优化平均得分只有1.66 1.66分,而全方法则得到6.40 6.40.
AIME制造了这种对比混凝土: Base, TextGrad,和EMO得分25.0 25.0分,26.7 26.7分和45.0 45.0分.
因此,从上下文改写中获得的有限收益不一定意味着适应范围有限:引导可以进一步利用这些改写引起的分配变化。

blocks.en:
Qwen3-8B and Llama-3.1-8B allow a cross-family comparison at matched parameter scale.
On MMLU-Pro, their accuracy gap shrinks from 18.2 18.2 points at Base to 3.6 3.6 after applying EMO to both models.
The corresponding gaps shrink from 31.8 31.8 to 17.4 17.4 on MATH-500 and from 9.3 9.3 to 2.9 2.9 on GSM8K.
Steering contributes directly to the MMLU-Pro result: its increment over TextGrad is 10.0 10.0 points for Llama versus 2.7 2.7 for Qwen.
On Llama-3.1-8B/MATH-500, however, TextGrad already reaches 65.4 65.4 versus EMO’s 65.6 65.6 .
The narrowed family gaps therefore reflect task-dependent contributions from context refinement and steering.
blocks.zh:
Qune3-8B和Llama-3.1-8B允许在相匹配参数尺度下进行跨家族比较.
在MMLU-Pro上,它们的精度差从Base的18.2 18.2分缩小到将EMO应用于两种模型后3.6 3.6分.
相应的缺口从MATH-500上的31.8个31.8个缩小到17.4个17.4个;从GSM8K上的9.3个9.3个缩小到2.9个.
指导直接有助于MMLU-Pro结果:其比TextGrad的增量为:Llama为10.0分,而Quen为2.7分.
然而,在Llama-3.1-8B/MATH-500上,TextGrad已经达到了65.4 65.4, 而EMO的65.6 65.6。
因此,家庭差距的缩小反映了环境的完善和指导对任务依赖性的贡献。

blocks.en:
The non-thinking Qwen2.5-7B, Llama-3.1-8B, and Llama-3.2-3B gain 9.64 9.64 , 12.22 12.22 , and 12.96 12.96 points on average.
Qwen2.5-7B also exceeds TextGrad on all five task groups, showing that M-step gains do not require a native thinking mode.
Models with thinking modes also improve: the Qwen3 series gains 7.44 7.44 – 9.42 9.42 points, and the reasoning-distilled DR1-Qwen3-8B gains 6.02 6.02 .
DR1 improves over Base on all five task groups, showing that reasoning distillation leaves scope for question-specific adaptation.
Yet its M-step increment is − 0.64 -0.64 points on average, with an additional gain only on MMLU-Pro ( 68.2 68.2 vs. 67.0 67.0 ).
DR1 and Qwen3.5-9B therefore have similar overall gains ( 6.02 6.02 vs. 6.40 6.40 ) but contrasting M-step contributions ( − 0.64 -0.64 vs. + 4.74 +4.74 ).
One possible explanation is that distillation reshapes context-conditioned distributions and their sensitivity to logit interventions, altering the benefit of a fixed steering rule.
Establishing this mechanism requires matched pre-/post-distillation controls.

Across these axes, MMLU-Pro provides the most consistent steering gains : all eight models exceed TextGrad, by 3.76 3.76 points on average.

At equal candidate counts, these results associate steering gains with broader coverage; mixed GPQA-D results show that multiple-choice format alone does not explain the effect.
Figure 1 shows how the advantage develops across rounds on Qwen3-14B/GPQA-D.
From a shared 52.5 52.5 baseline, EMO continues improving to 65.2 65.2 , while TextGrad levels off near 56 56 – 59 59 and ends at 58.1 58.1 .
EMO’s oracle curve also remains above TextGrad’s after the first update, reaching 79.8 79.8 at K = 4 K=4 .
Because oracle coverage does not depend on final answer selection, the curves indicate that improved candidate generation contributes to the 7.1 7.1 -point accuracy advantage.
We next analyze components, generation budgets, and selection (Section 4.5 ).

blocks.en:
In the sampling experiments, the first two optimization rounds capture roughly 70 70 – 89 % 89\% of the final gain in five of six Qwen3-8B and Llama-3.1-8B model–task pairs (Appendix Table 10 ); on Llama-3.2-3B the corresponding range is 65 65 – 81 % 81\% .

At N = 9 N=9 , EMO’s five-candidate oracle coverage exceeds that of nine independent samples in seven of nine settings (Appendix Table 13 ).
Figure 2(a) illustrates the largest coverage advantage, on Llama-3.1-8B/GPQA-D.

At the other extreme, Llama-3.2-3B/AIME has oracle coverage of only 3.3 3.3 and 6.7 6.7 on the two editions (Appendix Table 8 ), so better selection alone would yield limited gains.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
EMO couples question-specific context optimization with logits steering, using each response to refine the context that guides the next generation.
Its logit-space analysis clarifies this connection and identifies conditions for one-round target-KL improvement.
Across eight models and six benchmarks, the results show that model scaling and reasoning distillation leave scope for adaptation, with steering benefits that depend on the model and task.
The broader implication is to treat generation and verification as coupled uses of test-time computation.
Feedback can make further attempts more productive, while reliable selection determines how much of their expanded coverage reaches the final answer.
This perspective motivates inference systems that adjust context revision, decoding strength, and verification effort jointly to the bottleneck encountered during reasoning.
blocks.zh:
EMO夫妇用对数引导对特定背景进行优化,利用每个响应来完善指导下一代的背景.
它的对数空间分析澄清了这种联系,并确定了改进一回合目标KL的条件。
在8个模型和6个基准中,结果显示模型的缩放和推理提炼为适应留出了空间,其指导效益取决于模型和任务。
更广泛的影响是将生成和核查视为同时使用试验时间计算。
反馈可以使进一步的努力更有成效,而可靠的选择则决定它们扩大的覆盖面中有多少达到最后答案。
这一视角激励了调整上下文修改、解码强度和核查努力的推断系统共同应对推理过程中遇到的瓶颈。

blocks.en:
External judging can introduce misleading feedback or miss correct candidates.
Calibrated ranking and independent checks of reasoning steps or tool outputs could improve verification; retrieval and multiple optimization trajectories could address low candidate coverage.
Distribution access and two model streams limit deployment, and generation-equivalent budgets omit judge/rewrite costs.
Smaller judges, selective M-step activation, and adaptive stopping could reduce overhead; evaluations should measure total tokens, FLOPs, and latency.
Text-only interfaces could use response-level refinement and reranking, subject to separate evaluation.
The one-round guarantee assumes successful context updates and faithful steering over full softmax distributions; it does not certify default settings or monotonic accuracy.
Context-update acceptance checks, adaptive steering strength, and fallback to context-only decoding could improve robustness, using observable signals such as verifier disagreement and score margins.
Evaluation is limited to reasoning benchmarks in two model families.
Alternative judges, multilingual tasks, long-context workflows, and tool-using agents would test transfer and error accumulation over longer adaptation cycles.
blocks.zh:
外部判断可能引入误导性反馈或错过正确的候选人.
对推理步骤或工具产出进行校正排名和独立检查可以改进核查;检索和多重优化轨迹可以解决候选人覆盖率低的问题。
分配准入和两个模式流限制部署,生成等同预算省去了法官/改写费用。
较小的法官、有选择的M步启动和适应性停止可以减少间接费用;评价应当衡量总的标志、FLOP和耐久性。
只有文本的接口可以使用响应级的改进并重新排序,但须接受单独的评价.
一回合保证假设上下文更新成功并忠实地引导全软马克斯分布;它不认证默认设置或单调精度.
上下文更新的接受度检查、适应性引导强度和回溯到上下文的解码可以提高稳健性,使用可观测到的信号,如核查者分歧和分数幅度。
评价仅限于两个模范家庭的推理基准。
替代法官、多语种任务、长文本工作流程和工具使用代理将测试较长的适应周期的转移和错误积累。

The full MMLU-Pro test set contains 12,032 questions across 14 subject categories with up to 10 options each.

The sampling procedure is implemented in datasets/process_mmlu_pro.py and is exactly reproducible: rng = random.Random(42) sampled = [rng.sample(cat_items[c], 40) for c in categories] Prompts are constructed from the question stem and the full option block, with the output format Answer: $LETTER$ and a step-by-step instruction.

blocks.en:
DeepSeek-R1-0528-Qwen3-8B was obtained by post-training Qwen3-8B-Base on chain-of-thought traces distilled from DeepSeek-R1-0528 ( DeepSeek-AI, 2025 ) .
EMO improves its own Base on all five task groups ( + 6.02 +6.02 points on average), demonstrating that this distilled checkpoint retains scope for test-time adaptation.
Its mean M-step increment over TextGrad is − 0.64 -0.64 , although MMLU-Pro improves by 1.2 1.2 points; thus the benefits of the full adaptation loop and of steering must be distinguished.
A possible explanation is that distillation changes the conditional distributions on which steering operates.
In Eq. 5 , both the softmax Jacobian 𝐉 P opt \mathbf{J}_{P_{\mathrm{opt}}} and the context-induced displacement Δ ​ 𝐳 t \Delta\mathbf{z}_{t} depend on the checkpoint; changes to either can alter the steering vector even with fixed μ \mu and α \alpha .
Our Qwen3-8B comparison is not a controlled pre-/post-distillation pair, so this remains a mechanistic hypothesis.
Testing it would require matched checkpoints, contexts, prefixes, and decoding budgets, measuring conditional entropy, context-induced logit displacements, and reference-token probability changes.
The current accuracy results do not establish reduced entropy, overconfidence, or reinforcement-learning saturation.
For this model we report the v2 rerun with an extended generation budget (16,384 tokens), as its verbose thinking chains saturate the default 8,192-token cap (Appendix B.3 ).

blocks.en:
The judge is Qwen3.5-122B-A10B (FP8), served with vLLM (tensor parallelism 4, max context 32,768, CUDA graphs enabled).
In the greedy main experiments, the target model and all judge-side calls—scoring, feedback, backward, and context rewriting—use greedy decoding.
In the sampling experiments, judge scoring remains greedy with disk caching, while feedback, backward, and context rewriting use temperature 0.7 0.7 , top- p p 0.95 0.95 , and no caching.
Scoring and E-step calls use separate engine instances.
Both engines disable the judge’s thinking mode.
The judge never sees the gold answer; its prompt requires it to independently solve the problem, score 0–10, and—critically—produce feedback without revealing or hinting at the final answer (numbers, letters, or expressions), which keeps the E-step gradient estimate free of answer leakage.
An additional regex filter rejects any rewritten context that leaks a concrete answer, retaining the previous context in that case.

在采样实验中,法官评分仍然以磁盘缓存而贪婪,而反馈,后向,和上下文重写则使用温度0.7 0.7,上-p 0.95 0.95,没有缓存.
Scoring和E-step呼叫使用单独的引擎实例.
两个引擎都使法官的思维模式失效。
法官从不看金子答案;它的及时性要求它独立地解决问题,得分为0-10,并且——批判性地——产生反馈,而不透露或暗示最后答案(数字,字母,或表达),这使得E步梯度估计不漏出答案.

blocks.en:
An early version of the math_boxed scorer hard-extracted digits from non-numeric boxed answers (e.g., 7 ​ π → 7 7\pi\to 7 ), systematically under-reporting MATH-500 accuracy.
After fixing the extraction cascade, we rescored all affected stored responses with the corrected rule (flips occur only on MATH-500; GPQA/MMLU/GSM8K/AIME are unchanged), and all numbers in this paper use the rescored values.
The rescored greedy baseline of Qwen3-8B on MATH-500 ( 75.0 75.0 ) is consistent with the independently run sampling baseline ( 79.6 ± 0.4 79.6{\pm}0.4 at temperature 0.6), validating the fix.

在修复取出级联后,我们用修正的规则重新计分了所有受影响的存储响应(只出现在MATH-500上;GPQA/MMLU/GSM8K/AIME没有改变),本文中的所有数字都使用重计值.
MATH-500(75.0 75.0 )上被重新记分的贪婪基线Qwen3-8B与独立运行的采样基线(79.6±0.4 79.6~pm}0.4温度为0.6)一致,验证了固定.

blocks.en:
Llama-3.1/3.2 occasionally enter repetitive loops, filling the entire generation budget with a short cycle.
Beyond the standard exact-cycle detector (10–30 token loops), we add an information-saturation detector: once a generation exceeds 4,000 tokens, it is terminated early if the novel-token rate over each of the last three 200-token windows falls below 0.10 0.10 relative to a 400-token baseline window.
On a calibration set the detector hits 97 % 97\% of degenerate chains with 0 % 0\% false positives on normal chains and speeds up MATH-500 by ∼ 12 × {\sim}12\times .
Degenerate responses are almost always incorrect, so early termination has negligible effect on accuracy.

The TextGrad (no-M-step) arm shares its baseline and iter-0 responses with the EMO arm by construction ( reuse-baseline/iter0-from ), so both arms start from an identical state and diverge only from iteration 1 onward.
In the sampling experiments the no-M-step arm additionally reuses the same sharding, guaranteeing a 1:1 question match across arms.
blocks.zh:
TextGrad(无-M-step)臂与EMO臂通过构造(再利用-基线/iter0-从.)共享其基线和Iter-0反应,因此两臂都从一个相同的状态起步,只与第1次重复。
在取样试验中,无M步臂额外地再用同一种硬化,保证了1:1个问题对接。

blocks.en:
Each optimization round generates one response using two context-conditioned model streams. Including the initial generation, EMO@ k k uses N = 2 ​ k + 1 N=2k+1 target-model generation equivalents and produces k + 1 k+1 candidates. Section 4.4 matches this budget to N N independent samples for SC/BoN; the accounting excludes judge/rewrite calls, response-length differences, and latency.
Judge throughput is not a bottleneck: with CUDA graphs, the 122B FP8 judge sustains ∼ 22 {\sim}22 concurrent scoring workers per 4-GPU instance.

每个优化回合使用两个上下文条件模型流生成一个响应. 包括初代,EMO@kk使用N=2克+1N=2克+1目标型式生成等同物并产生k+1克+1候选. 第4.4节将这一预算与在册种姓/在册部落的N类独立样本相匹配;核算不包括法官/重写电话、答复长度差异和延迟。
法官吞吐量并不是一个瓶颈:用CUDA的图表,122B FP8法官维持了每4个GPU案例22个同时评分的工人。

blocks.en:
The SC/BoN comparison shares the sampling pool of the top- p p experiments: for each question we draw n = 10 n{=}10 i.i.d. samples at temperature 0.6 0.6 , top- p p 0.95 0.95 , with the same per-model generation budget and the same seeds { 0 , 1 , 2 } \{0,1,2\} as the EMO sampling runs. BoN@ N N selects, among the first N N samples, the one with the highest judge score (the same scoring engine and prompt as EMO’s judge-select, ties broken toward the earlier sample) and reports its rule-based correctness. SC@ N N takes a majority vote over the extracted final answers of the first N N samples (the same extraction rules as the main scoring pipeline); a sample whose answer cannot be extracted abstains, and if all N N abstain the first sample’s rule-based verdict is used.

blocks.en:
Figures 3 – 8 plot the accuracy of the judge-selected response (solid lines) and the pass@ n n oracle upper bound (dashed lines) against the EMO iteration n n , for all 8 models on each of the six datasets.
All curves are computed from the greedy main experiments, with the baseline (grey dashed line) scored under the same unified judge.
Throughout this subsection, iteration n ∈ { 1 , … , 5 } n\in\{1,\dots,5\} counts the baseline round as n = 1 n{=}1 (i.e., iteration n n corresponds to index iter n − 1 n{-}1 elsewhere).

blocks.en:
Three patterns emerge. (i) Early convergence. Across the 44 (model, task) pairs with a non-saturated gain ( ≥ 2 \geq 2 points), iteration 2 already realizes on average about half of the final gain of EMO, and on saturated tasks (GSM8K for the Qwen3 family) the curve flattens after a single iteration.
The main exceptions are the hardest tasks (AIME, GPQA-D for weak models), where gains accrue through iteration 4—consistent with headroom being unlocked late when the base policy is far from the target. (ii) Steering benefits depend on the task beyond its answer format. On MMLU-Pro the pass@5 of EMO exceeds that of TextGrad for all 8 models (mean gap + 9.6 +9.6 points, up to + 17.9 +17.9 for Llama-3.1-8B: 74.5 74.5 vs. 56.6 56.6 ), and the selected accuracy likewise wins 8 / 8 8/8 .
On free-form mathematics (MATH-500, GSM8K), the mean pass@5 gap is at most 1.4 1.4 points, suggesting that context refinement already provides most of the observed coverage.
However, GPQA-D also uses multiple-choice answers and exhibits mixed selected-accuracy effects, so answer format alone cannot account for the MMLU-Pro pattern.
The results motivate testing whether the quality of context-induced distribution shifts, rather than output format, predicts when steering helps. (iii) Candidate coverage and selection can improve at different rates. On Qwen3-14B/GPQA-D, EMO reaches 79.8 79.8 pass@5 against 65.2 65.2 selected accuracy.
The gap shows that correct candidates are available for additional questions but are not always selected; by itself, it does not measure semantic diversity.
Rising coverage across rounds establishes that later attempts solve previously uncovered questions, motivating stronger verification to realize these gains (Section 4.5 ).

blocks.en:
Table 9 repeats the component ablation of Table 3 on Qwen3-32B.
The cross-scale comparison distinguishes three forms of component dependence.
First, steering and external judging can contribute differently even within AIME.
With the external judge, the M-step ties context-only optimization on AIME-2025 ( 43.3 43.3 ) but adds 10.0 10.0 points on AIME-2026 ( 53.3 53.3 vs. 43.3 43.3 ).
With steering retained, external judging adds 13.3 13.3 and 6.6 6.6 points over self-judging, respectively; neither component is uniformly dominant across editions.
Second, steering on GPQA-D loses 2.5 2.5 points under both judge choices ( 62.1 62.1 vs. 64.6 64.6 externally judged; 61.6 61.6 vs. 64.1 64.1 self-judged).
This differs from Qwen3-8B, where replacing the self-judge with the external judge changes the steering increment from − 3.5 -3.5 to + 2.1 +2.1 .
Feedback quality and steering utility can interact, but external judging does not universally resolve an unfavorable steering effect.
Third, with steering retained, the external-judge increment on MMLU-Pro changes from + 2.3 +2.3 at 8B to − 1.1 -1.1 at 32B, where self-judging reaches 75.4 75.4 versus 74.3 74.3 .
This reversal motivates model- and task-dependent judge allocation, but does not establish better intrinsic self-evaluation at 32B: judge replacement changes both feedback and candidate selection, and the greedy comparison does not estimate uncertainty across runs.
Occasional repetitive-generation failures under self-judging are documented in Appendix B.3 .

At N = 9 N=9 , EMO’s five-candidate coverage exceeds the nine-sample SC/BoN coverage in seven of nine pairs.
The largest gap is on Llama-3.1-8B/GPQA-D ( 73.7 73.7 vs. 60.3 60.3 ); the two exceptions are Qwen3-8B/GPQA-D ( 79.1 79.1 vs. 80.0 80.0 ) and Qwen3-8B/MATH-500 ( 90.4 90.4 vs. 90.9 90.9 ), where independent sampling retains an edge.

blocks.en:
Because a correct selected response must belong to a pool containing a correct response, selected accuracy divided by oracle coverage measures the fraction of covered questions on which selection succeeds.
We compute this descriptive ratio from the reported three-seed means; with equal evaluation-set sizes, it corresponds to pooling question–seed outcomes, rather than averaging per-seed ratios.
At N = 9 N=9 on Llama-3.1-8B/GPQA-D, the ratio is 37.4 / 73.7 ≈ 50.7 % 37.4/73.7\approx 50.7\% for EMO and 32.2 / 60.3 ≈ 53.4 % 32.2/60.3\approx 53.4\% for BoN.
EMO’s accuracy advantage therefore coexists with a lower fraction of available successes realized by selection: its greater coverage is essential to the observed advantage.
On Llama-3.1-8B/MATH-500, both coverage ( 73.4 73.4 vs. 71.9 71.9 ) and this fraction ( 89.4 % 89.4\% vs. 84.6 % 84.6\% ) favor EMO.
The same pattern appears on Llama-3.2-3B/MATH-500 (Figure 2(b) ): EMO’s coverage is 70.6 70.6 versus BoN’s 66.5 66.5 , and its selected-to-covered fraction is 60.3 / 70.6 ≈ 85.4 % 60.3/70.6\approx 85.4\% versus 52.7 / 66.5 ≈ 79.2 % 52.7/66.5\approx 79.2\% .
These are descriptive relationships, not isolated causal effects of ranking: candidate pools and the questions they cover differ across methods.
They show why a larger absolute oracle–accuracy gap need not indicate less useful generation, and why selection quality alone cannot explain all accuracy gains.

Llama-3.2-B/MATH-500(图2(b))上也出现同样的模式:EMO的覆盖率为70.6 70.6,而BON的覆盖率为66.5 66.5, 其选定的至覆盖分数为60.3 / 70.6 = 85.4 = 60.3/70.6 = 85.4 = 52.7 / 66.5 = 79.2 = 52.7/66.5 = 79.2 = 79.2 = = 。

blocks.en:
At N = 9 N=9 on Llama-3.1-8B/MMLU-Pro, SC and BoN share 76.4 76.4 oracle coverage but achieve 51.4 51.4 and 62.5 62.5 accuracy, respectively.
Thus many available correct responses are not recovered by majority voting, while judge selection realizes more of the same pool’s potential.

This contrast suggests that feedback-guided adaptation is most useful where independent sampling and its selection rule leave recoverable errors; it need not dominate when repeated sampling already supplies effective candidates and reliable consensus.

blocks.en: B.4.5 Statistical Significance of Sampling Results

blocks.en:
Table 14 reports paired significance tests for the top- p p sampling experiments (three models × \times three tasks).
Each comparison pairs the same question under the same seed, pooling the three seeds ( n n = questions × \times 3).
We apply two-sided paired t t -tests and Wilcoxon signed-rank tests, with Holm–Bonferroni correction over the 18 reported comparisons per test (nine against Base and nine against BoN@10).
The BoN significance comparisons use ten independent samples against EMO’s nine target-model generation equivalents; the matched-budget comparisons in Section 4.4 use BoN@9.
Reported Δ \Delta is the accuracy difference in percentage points between the two arms.

Two patterns emerge. blocks.en: B.5 Hyperparameter Analysis
blocks.zh: B.5 超参数分析

blocks.en:
The M-step steering has two hyperparameters: the total strength μ \mu and the confidence threshold α \alpha that masks low-confidence tokens (Section 3.2.2 ).
Table 15 sweeps them on Qwen3-8B over GPQA-Diamond (greedy, all other settings identical to the main experiments).
blocks.zh:
M步方向盘有两个超参数:总强度为μ \ mu;置信阈值为α α α,以遮蔽低自信的符(第 3.2.2 节).
表15在Qwen3-8B上将它们扫过GPQA-Diamond(greedy,所有其他与主要实验完全相同的设置).

blocks.en: Table 15: Hyperparameter sweep on Qwen3-8B / GPQA-Diamond (accuracy %, greedy; base = 49.0 =49.0 ). Panel (a) sweeps the total strength μ \mu at α = 0.1 \alpha{=}0.1 ; panel (b) sweeps the confidence threshold α \alpha at μ = 2.4 \mu{=}2.4 . The main-experiment default ( μ = 2.4 \mu{=}2.4 , α = 0.1 \alpha{=}0.1 ) attains 56.6 56.6 ( + 7.6 +7.6 ).

blocks.en:
Across a 2 × 2\times range of the total strength ( μ ∈ [ 1.6 , 3.2 ] \mu\in[1.6,3.2] ) the gain stays within 5.6 5.6 – 7.6 7.6 points with no monotone trend: μ = 1.6 \mu=1.6 and the default μ = 2.4 \mu=2.4 tie for the highest observed accuracy ( 56.6 56.6 ), and no setting collapses.
This indicates that the KL-gradient signal (Section 3.2.2 ) is a robust direction—once the update points toward the optimized context, its magnitude is of secondary importance.
blocks.zh:
在总强度的2×2相差范围内(μ××[1.6,3.2]\mu\ in[1.6,3.2]) 5.6 — 7.6 7.6分以内,没有单调趋势: μ = 1.6\mu = 1.6; 默认 μ = 2.4\mu = 2.4 = 2.4 平分最高观测精度(56.6 56.6),没有设置崩溃。
这表明KL梯度信号(第3.2.2节)是一个稳健的方向——一旦更新点指向最佳环境,其规模就具有次要的重要性。

blocks.en:
The picture changes qualitatively for α \alpha .
At α = 0.05 \alpha{=}0.05 the gain collapses to + 1.0 +1.0 : with too permissive a mask, the steering vector acts on tokens where the optimized context expresses almost no preference, injecting noise rather than signal.
At α = 0.1 \alpha{=}0.1 – 0.4 0.4 the gain is stable ( + 7.6 +7.6 to + 9.6 +9.6 , with the best value at α = 0.2 \alpha{=}0.2 ), i.e., the constraint only needs to separate confident tokens from noise, not to be tuned precisely.
We conclude that the confidence mask, not the step size, is the load-bearing hyperparameter of the M-step, and keep the conservative default α = 0.1 \alpha{=}0.1 throughout the main experiments (where it already attains the + 7.6 +7.6 gain reported above).
blocks.zh:
照片在质量上对α-α有所改变。
α = 0.05\α{=}0.05 增益倒数为+1.0+1.0 :由于过于宽放的口罩,方向矢量在被优化的上下文几乎不表示偏好,注入噪音而不是信号的符号上作用.
在α = 0.1\alpha{=}0.1 – 0.4 得到的增益是稳定的(+ 7.6 + 7.6 + 9.6 + 9.6),最佳值为 α = 0.2\alpha{=}0.2 ),即制约只需要将自信的标志与噪音区分开来,而不是精确地调取.
我们的结论是,置信口罩,而不是步长,是M步的负载超参数,在整个主要实验中保持保守的默认为 α = 0.1\ alpha{=}0.1 (在主要实验中,它已经实现了上面报告的 + 7.6 + 7.6 增益)。

blocks.en: B.6 Prompt Templates
blocks.zh: B.6 快速模板

blocks.en:
This section documents the four prompts that drive the E-step (Section 3 ): the judge that scores responses, the backward engine that produces the textual gradient, the optimizer that rewrites the context, and the answer-leakage filter that guards the whole loop.
All prompts are task-agnostic (the same templates are used for all six benchmarks); the question stem and option block are the only task-specific inputs.
blocks.zh:
本节记录了驱动 E-step (第 3 节) 的四个提示:评分响应的评分,生成文字梯度的后向引擎,重写上下文的优化器,以及守护整个循环的答漏过滤器.
所有提示都是任务不可知的(所有6个基准都使用相同的模板);提问干和选项块是唯一针对任务的投入.

blocks.en: B.6.1 Judge Scoring Prompt
blocks.zh: B.6.1 法官速报

blocks.en:
The judge prompt ( _EVAL_SYSTEM_PROMPT in trainer.py ) instructs the judge model to grade a response on a 0–10 scale while remaining blind to the gold answer.
Its key requirements are: (i) solve the problem independently before grading, never assuming the model’s answer is correct; (ii) 10 means the final answer is correct, 0 means wrong or missing, with partial credit (1–9) for substantive progress on incorrect solutions; (iii) the feedback must locate the methodological error and how to fix it without ever revealing or hinting at the final answer (no numbers, letters, or expressions); (iv) no restating of the question or response.
blocks.zh:
裁判提示 (_EVAL_SYSTEM_PROMPT in trainer.py) 指示裁判模型在保持对金子答案视而不见的同时,按 0–10 分级回应.
其主要要求是:(一)在分级前独立解决问题,绝不假定模型的答案是正确的;(二)10指最终答案是正确的,0指错误或缺失,对不正确的解决方案的实质性进展给予部分的信用(1–9); (三)反馈必须找到方法错误以及如何纠正它而不对最终答案有任何启示或暗示(没有数字,字母,或表达);(四)不重述问题或回应.
问题 : {问题\ n答复 :{答复\ n}{ 评估这一对策。 提供详细的反馈和分数。

blocks.en: The judge returns its output in the format <FEEDBACK>...</FEEDBACK><SCORE>0-10</SCORE> ; the score drives judge-select (Appendix B.3 ) and the feedback becomes the input to the backward pass below.
blocks.zh: 评委以"FEEDBACK"的格式返回其输出. </FEEDBACKQSCORE > 0-10 </SCORE";分数驱动评委-选取(Appendix B.3),反馈成为向下方后传输入.

blocks.en: B.6.2 Backward (Text Gradient) Prompt
blocks.zh: B.6.2 向后(梯度)迅速

blocks.en:
The backward prompt ( BACKWARD_SYSTEM_PROMPT in llm_backward_prompts.py ) asks the engine to act as the “gradient” with respect to the context variable: given the current system prompt, the question, the model’s response, and the judge feedback, produce criticism of the context —strategies, explanations, and methods to change—but never a rewritten version of the variable (that is the optimizer’s job).
It carries the same no-leakage and conciseness clauses as the judge prompt.
The gradient is injected through a structured conversation template:
blocks.zh:
PROMPT in llm_backward_prompts.py )要求引擎在上下文变量方面起到“渐入”的作用:考虑到目前的系统即时性,问题,模型的反应,以及法官的反馈,对上下文产生批评——策略,解释,以及改变的方法——但绝不是变量的重写版本(即优化者的工作).
它载有法官所提示的同样不漏和简洁的条款。
通过结构化的对话模板来注入梯度 :

blocks.en: <LM_SYSTEM_PROMPT>{system_prompt}</LM_SYSTEM_PROMPT> <LM_INPUT>{prompt}</LM_INPUT> <LM_OUTPUT>{response}</LM_OUTPUT> <FEEDBACK>{feedback}</FEEDBACK>
blocks.zh: <LM_SYSTEM_PROMPT>{ system_prompt}</LM_SYSTEM_PROMPT> (中文(简体) ). <LM_INPUT>%%% 1 /LM_INPUT> <LM_OUTPUT> 答复 {/LM_UTPUT> 页面存档备份,存于互联网档案馆 "FEEDBACK"

blocks.en: Note that the full response is embedded in the backward prompt; this is the main driver of the judge-context length budget ( ∼ 14.5 {\sim}14.5 k tokens at peak for our longest responses).
blocks.zh: 要注意的是,完整的响应嵌入了落后的提示;这是法官-文本长度预算的主要驱动力(  14.5 {\ sim} 14.5 k sords at highs for our longer response).

blocks.en: B.6.3 Optimizer (Context Rewrite) Prompt
blocks.zh: B.6.3 优化(重写)提示

blocks.en:
The optimizer prompt ( OPTIMIZER_SYSTEM_PROMPT in optimizer_prompts.py ) implements the TGD update: improve the context variable using the feedback, returning the improved variable wrapped in {new_variable_start_tag} {improved variable} {new_variable_end_tag} tags so it can be extracted and replace the old context directly, with an instruction to keep the improved variable concise.
The update instruction passes the variable’s role, its current value, and the gradient from the backward pass.
What shapes the rewrite most is the role description attached to the context variable:
blocks.zh:
优化快取(OPSIZER_SYSTEM_PROMPT in expensiver_promts.py ) 执行 TGD 更新:利用反馈改进上下文变量,还原所包裹在{new_variable_start_tag}{改进了变量}{enew_variable_end_tag}标签,这样可以直接取出并替换旧上下文,并用一个指令来保持所改进的可变简洁.
更新指令会传递变量的角色,其当前值,以及从后向传递的梯度.
重写最多的是上下文变量所附带的角色描述 :

blocks.en: “system prompt to guide the model’s behavior. A good system prompt establishes the model as a domain expert relevant to the task (e.g. ‘You are an expert chemist …’), states the key reasoning approach and pitfalls to avoid, and specifies the required output format. Avoid generic phrases; be specific to the question’s domain. Do NOT reveal or hint at the actual answer.”
blocks.zh: “系统提示来引导模型的行为。 一个良好的系统提示将模型确立为与任务相关的域专家(例如:"你是一个专家化学家."),说明要避免的关键推理方法和陷阱,并指定所需的输出格式. 避免通用语;针对问题领域。 不显示或提示实际答案。 “

blocks.en:
This steers the E-step away from generic encouragements (“think carefully”) toward substantive, domain-specific guidance, which is what the M-step steering vector can then convert into a decoding-time correction.
Optional momentum (past iterations), constraints, and in-context-example sections exist in the template but are disabled in all experiments reported in this paper.
blocks.zh:
这使E步从一般鼓励(“仔细思考”)转向实质性的、针对具体领域的指导,这就是M步方向矢量可以转换成解码时间的校正。
模板中存在可选动力(过去重复)、制约因素和内文-实例部分,但在本文所报告的所有实验中被禁用。

blocks.en: B.6.4 Answer-Leakage Filter
blocks.zh: B.6.4 答漏过滤器

blocks.en:
Two complementary guards keep the optimization signal free of the answer.
First, the judge never receives the gold answer, and its prompt explicitly forbids the feedback from revealing or hinting at the final answer (Appendix B.6.1 ).
Second, every context produced by the optimizer is passed through a regex filter ( _ANSWER_LEAK_PATTERNS in optimizer.py ) that rejects rewrites containing concrete answers—e.g. “the answer is X” patterns, contrastive “the answer is X, not Y” constructions, or specific numbers/letters—in which case the previous context is retained.
The v2 filter no longer false-positives on the output-format directive Answer: $LETTER$ : a literal $ is only treated as numeric leakage when followed by a digit.
Together these guards ensure that neither the judge feedback nor the optimized context can smuggle the gold answer into the generation path, so any accuracy gain is attributable to the optimization itself rather than to answer leakage.
blocks.zh:
两个辅助卫士保持优化信号无接应.
首先,法官从未收到黄金答案,其及时性明确禁止反馈透露或暗示最终答案(附录B.6.1)。
第二,由优化器产生的每一个上下文都会通过一个regex过滤器(在优化器.py中为_ANSWER_LEAK_PATERNS)来传递,拒绝包含具体答案的重写——例如. “答案是X”图案,具有对比性的“答案是X,而不是Y”构象,或者具体数字/字母——在这种情况下保留以前的上下文。
v2过滤器在输出格式指令上不再有假阳性 回答:$LETTER$:一个字元只有在数字之后才作为数字渗出处理.
这些卫士共同确保法官的反馈和最优化的上下文都不能将金子答案偷运入生成路径,因此任何精度增益都归功于优化本身而不是回答渗出.
